Metadata.title: BridgLabs — Software engineering by Bruno Pinheiro
Metadata.description: Software designed, built, and shipped by software engineer Bruno Pinheiro.

HomePage.headline: Hi, I’m Bruno
HomePage.bio: I am a software engineer with over 10 years of experience. Today I work at Blue River Technology, a John Deere company in Silicon Valley. BridgLabs is where I turn problems that bother me into software other people can use.

pinubi.description: Stop losing places saved from Reels, TikToks, and screenshots: Pinubi turns them into organized places on your map.
pinubi.engineeringDescription: A multimodal pipeline using scraping, Gemini, and Google Maps; evaluated in Langfuse at 95% recall and 97% precision.

destrua.description: Put two landing pages head to head and watch AI compare, critique, and pick the better one live — for free.
destrua.engineeringDescription: A 100% Cloudflare app with Hono, D1, and KV; automatic OpenRouter failover across 8 models and a generated social image for every battle.

pemuli.description: Late at night with a baby in your arms, logging feeds, diapers, and hydration cannot rely on memory. Pemuli handles it in a few taps, from your phone or watch.
pemuli.engineeringDescription: A local-first SwiftUI and Swift 6 app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, with Live Activities, Dynamic Island, widgets, and offline Watch sync.

HomePage.footerNote: Designed and built by Bruno Pinheiro.
